root_cause.text: The `usb_8dev` driver fails to re-anchor completed URBs to the `priv->rx_submitted` anchor in `usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback()` before resubmitting them, leaving them untracked and leaked when the anchor is cleared during device closure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &priv->rx_submitted)` before `usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC)` in `usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback()`, and the commit message explains that "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in usb_kill_anchored_urbs()."

bic_trace_step.reason: In `usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback()` (lines 561-574), the completed RX URB is resubmitted using `usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC)` without being re-anchored to `priv->rx_submitted` using `usb_anchor_urb()`. Since the USB core unanchors URBs before invoking their completion callbacks, the resubmitted URB becomes untracked. Consequently, when `unlink_all_urbs()` is called during device closure, `usb_kill_anchored_urbs(&priv->rx_submitted)` fails to kill these active URBs, leading to resource leaks and potential use-after-free issues.
